# Interface fonts

DM Serif Display (regular/italic) and Outfit (300–700), downloaded from the
Google Fonts CSS endpoint already used by the app. The same families are now
served locally through `css/fonts.css`, avoiding external font requests.

Each family is distributed under the SIL Open Font License; see its OFL file.
Source families: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/dmserifdisplay
and https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/outfit.
